rendered: According to the document, the V2O5 film thicknesses tested electrochemically were ∼80 nm and ∼40 nm. The thicker film (∼80 nm) was obtained with 1000 ALD cycles, while the thinner film (∼40 nm) was obtained with 500 ALD cycles. The potential shifts due to elastic strains were similar for both film thicknesses, with an average equilibrium potential variation of ∼40 mV.
